summary: Tears down a network-session-style object: runs a batch cleanup loop over the sub-object at this+0x4, frees the audio array elements and container at this+0x94, deallocates the sub-object at this+0x8, deallocates the object itself, then returns the result of a WSACleanup thunk call.

operations.description: Call BatchLoopWithMemoryCleanup(lpMem[1]) on the sub-object pointer stored at this+0x4 to clean up its memory entries.
Call DestroyAudioArrayFreeElementsThenContainer(lpMem[37]) on the audio element array pointer stored at this+0x94 to free its elements and container.
Call sub_58AA6F(lpMem[2]) to deallocate the sub-object pointer stored at this+0x8.
Call sub_58AA6F(lpMem) to deallocate the object itself.
Return the result of the WSACleanup thunk call.
